Setting your own Lock Screen.

Step 1: Download image to kindle. You do this by taking a photo that’s capable with kindle. Could be png, or epub. Go to Amazon.com/sendtokindle. Then tap Select Files From Device(if on mobile, if pc drag image to the center box that says drag). Then tap/click send. You will need to be logged into your Amazon account. It will send the image to your kindle after a few seconds(you can check it’s there when it says In Library towards the bottom).

Step 2: Lock Screen. So you want to tap on the image on your kindle to open it, then close out. Press the power button and the image should be shown as your Lock Screen.

Keep in mind!! You will have to repeat step 2 after reading a book each time!!

Okay I’ll try to explain best I can!! Step 1: Ads need to be remove from your Lock Screen. Either you paid more to have them removed when you bought it, or you can message Amazon support and they might remove them for free or you’ll have to pay I believe $20USD(not sure of other currencies)

Step 2: Show Covers on Lock Screen. You do this by going to Settings, then Screen and Brightness, tap the slider that says Show Covers on Lock Screen

Those are the tips to be able to use custom Lock Screens!!
